data_policy: Never assume all public GitHub code is licensed for model training.
Keep source URL, repository, path, license identifier, and content hash where possible.
Exclude secrets, private data, generated bundles, minified code, vendored dependencies, and benchmark answer leakage.
Use repository-level train/validation separation for credible evaluation.
Do not pad token targets with duplicates or low-quality synthetic examples.
